assessment_objectives.objective: responsible party(ies) that monitor the functionality and behavior of deployed Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Autonomous Technologies (AAT) are trained on identifying unmeasurable risks or trustworthiness characteristics.

unmeasurable risks or trustworthiness characteristics related to Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Autonomous Technologies (AAT) are reported in accordance with the organization's Incident Response Plan (IRP).
unmeasurable risks or trustworthiness characteristics related to Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Autonomous Technologies (AAT) are identified.

unmeasurable risks or trustworthiness characteristics related to Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Autonomous Technologies (AAT) are documented in a risk register, Plan of Action & Milestones (POA&M) or similar record.
